questions.text: What is the main tool this person needs to build first?
options: An internal tool for staff to handle daily work
A customer-facing sign-up and order flow
A self-service page for clients to track requests

questions.text: What messy data or everyday problem will they deal with?
options: Scattered spreadsheets and manual email updates
An old database full of duplicate entries
Separate software tools that do not share information

questions.text: What is the first useful result you want to see within a month?
options: A working screen where staff can edit records cleanly
A live web page where visitors can submit real requests
A simple automated view that replaces manual status reports
